title: Canonical quotient scalar-extension unit and associator
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and let $P_n=A/I^{n+1}$. On an essentially small site $J$, use the fixed scalar extension $E_J(q)$ adjoint to actual derived scalar restriction from [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. Define identity restriction by the identity maps on sections. Define its derived scalar-extension unit as the adjunction conjugate of that identity restriction. For quotient maps $q_{m,n}$ define $E_J(m,n)=E_J(q_{m,n})$, its self-extension unit $E_J(n,n)\cong\mathrm{id}$, and the three-level associator $E_J(k,m)E_J(m,n)\cong E_J(k,n)$ as the canonical conjugate of composition of restrictions, using $q_{m,n}q_{k,m}=q_{k,n}$. These are exactly the five existing normalizedOrigin definitions, relocated without any change of signature or body.
